Ana Rivera: brief sync: I want to propose an edge "attr-trim-proxy" — a small proxy that removes nonessential high-cardinality span attrs at ingress, but keeps a deterministic billing_key + a short-lived lookup token for later full-attr recovery when needed.
CJ Park: sounds useful for ingest cost. couple requirements: billing_key must be computed deterministically at the proxy and never rely on a later enrichment hop.
Michael Li: two obvious cons: 1) if we throw attrs away we break late-join enrichment unless we have a reliable token mechanism, and 2) debugging traces becomes harder without the original fields.
Ana Rivera: Recovery approach: when a route is marked "attr-sensitive", proxy writes full attrs to the short-lived store and emits envelope {billing_key, minimal_meta, recovery_token}. Otherwise it emits envelope without token.
Sara Gupta: sampling: important point. If sampling decision is after the proxy, we could lose attribution for unsampled traces. options: force sample decision at ingress for flagged routes OR attach token for potential late fetch.
CJ Park: token design: keep it tiny (sha256(trace_id+timestamp)), and only create tokens for traces that match the billing predicate to limit storage. store TTL=48h.
Michael Li: reuse existing short-lived enrichment-cache to avoid new infra. capacity question: if average attrs are ~1KB and we tag ~5% of 2M traces/day -> ~100GB/day, 48h => 200GB hot. CJ to validate.
Ana Rivera: derivation rule for billing_key: if tenant_billing_id present then use it; else edge does hash(tenant_id + route) so downstream billing can reconcile without fetching attrs.
CJ Park: ops/security: any persisted attrs must be KMS-encrypted at rest and access-controlled. enrichment workers need scoped credentials to fetch tokens.
Sara Gupta: fallback strategy if cache unreachable: emit full attrs (costly) or drop token and mark trace as missing_attrs; prefer emitting full attrs for safety but throttle if too expensive.
Michael Li: can we gate the proxy behaviour via per-route feature-flag and rollout with 0.5% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%? add an abort switch.
Ana Rivera: yes. rollout plan: start with internal-only routes, 0.5% traffic, 24h, monitor billing delta, attr-missing rates, and trace-debugging queries.
deploy-bot: Note: added ticket INF-6283 "edge-attr-trim-proxy" to deploy board (owner: CJ Park). :robot_face:
Ana Rivera: Action items: CJ -> capacity + cost estimate spreadsheet; Michael -> verify enrichment-cache API for token writes/reads; Sara -> define SLI for "attr-recoverability" and monitoring checks; Ana -> update RFC with config examples and pseudocode. target: behind feature-flag in 2 sprints.
CJ Park: ack. will post numbers and a short API compatibility checklist tomorrow.
Michael Li: I'll spike on cache integration and report back.
Sara Gupta: drafting SLIs now and will add to the ticket.
Ana Rivera: thanks — fallback posture is always to emit full attrs until we verify correctness. :thumbsup:
